'''Raykos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[captain]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], stationed in the [[Imperial First Mobile Fleet]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Reputation vendor for Imperial Heroic space missions, Captain Raykos was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 1.7: Return of the Gree on [[February 12]], [[2013]].<ref name="TOR" />
